name: EVIDENCE_GROUNDED_PROMPT_CONTRACT
purpose: Define a controlled prompt boundary for the local LLM.
Preserve provenance, uncertainty, and knowledge gaps.
Ensure observations remain separate from model-generated inferences.

prompt_sections.purpose: Define the model's permitted role and safety restrictions.
Provide only explicitly supplied evidence records.
Identify the source associated with each evidence item.
Constrain the response to the validated output structure.
Prevent unsupported inference and automatic decisions.

grounding_rules: Use only evidence explicitly supplied in the prompt context.
Do not attribute unsupported claims to a source.
Do not convert an inference into an observation.
When evidence is insufficient, explicitly state that evidence is insufficient.
Do not present model memory as supplied evidence.
observation_rules: Observations must be directly traceable to supplied evidence.
Each observation must retain its evidence identifier.
Observations must not contain unsupported causal conclusions.
inference_rules: Inferences must be explicitly labeled as inference.
Every inference must identify supporting evidence.
Inference confidence must not exceed the evidence support.
If supporting evidence is inadequate, the inference must be rejected or marked unsupported.
provenance_rules: Every evidence item must have a source identifier.
PMID provenance must be retained when applicable.
The model must not generate replacement provenance.
Missing provenance must trigger validation failure.
uncertainty_rules: The model must not convert uncertainty into certainty.
Uncertainty must remain visible in the output.
knowledge_gap_rules: Existing knowledge gaps must be preserved.
The model must not silently fill knowledge gaps.
Knowledge gaps may be identified but not fabricated as facts.
forbidden_behaviors: Claiming external verification without supplied evidence
